Slowly getting around to fleshing out the little UI details that make a program more polished and easier to use.

The Workspace Summary now contains buttons indicating what Instrument Lists are being displayed.

With this update, you no longer have to bring up the Lists dialog to find out what the window you’re currently looking at has in it, which is really handy when you have a lot of windows open at the same time.

Stocky is the MacOS native application I am building for fetching, organizing and interpreting financial data for investing. You can read more about it here.

https://red82.com/stocky/
